adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and adds per-credential calendar selection only in `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent(...)`, which now finds `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`. In contrast, Lark (`packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`), Office365 (`packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`), and the base CalDAV/iCal flow (`packages/lib/CalendarService.ts`) all destructure `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` and use only that first entry’s `externalId`, ignoring the `credentialId` passed via `CalendarManager.createEvent` (`calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`). Meanwhile `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates all `event.destinationCalendar` entries and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`, but that `externalId` is not used to select a calendar in these non-Google providers, so they will create events using `destinationCalendar[0]` even when operating under a different host credential.
